title: Orin's Netherstone

sources.title: Triune Netherstone
markers: | description = {{story|Triune Netherstone}} is a quest item obtained at the end of [[Act Three]].

sources.title: Karsus' Compulsion
markers: | summary = It is granted by the {{SmRarityItem|Triune Netherstone}} and is usable only by [[Full-Illithid]]s to control the [[Crown of Karsus]].

sources.title: Confront the Elder Brain
markers: | description = Confront the Elder Brain is a quest in Act Three of Baldur's Gate 3.

summary: Collect Orin’s Netherstone to confront the Netherbrain.

fields.Acquisition: Loot Orin’s Netherstone-Pommelled Bloodthirst. It splits into the dagger and her Netherstone.
fields.Quest use: Bring this stone and the stones from Ketheric and Gortash to the Morphic Pool. They combine into the Triune Netherstone. A full illithid can use Karsus’ Compulsion on the Crown from 20 ft and must maintain the channel until the next turn.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
